retention.stated: Fetching the same object with the signature stripped and the filename changed still returned 200 with the identical 498,804 bytes. So Intercom CDN URLs are effectively unauthenticated and permanent, which is a reusable pattern (and means 'signed' URLs elsewhere may also be decorative).
retention.notes: By default Intercom retains the stored attachment file indefinitely. The 30-minute and around-6-month windows are access-token validity only and do not delete the file; deleting the attachment or the message revokes access immediately.
